title: FoRAG: Factuality-optimized Retrieval Augmented Generation for Web-enhanced Long-form Question Answering

problem.claim: Web-enhanced long-form question-answering requires generated answers with factuality and clear logic.

gap.claim: Existing open-source methods and web-enhanced commercial systems leave factuality and clear logic in generated long-form answers unresolved.

contributions.claim: A novel outline-enhanced generator for improving the logical organization of multifaceted answers, accompanied by two datasets.
A factuality optimization method based on doubly fine-grained RLHF with automatic evaluation and reward modeling at different granularities.
A generic framework that includes conventional fine-grained RLHF methods as special cases.

stated_novelty.claim: The authors explicitly describe the outline-enhanced generator as novel.

author_reported_evidence.claim: The authors report that FoRAG outperforms on English and Chinese benchmarks.
Applied to Llama2-7B-chat, FoRAG-L-7B reportedly outperforms WebGPT-175B on coherence, helpfulness, and factuality while using one twenty-fourth as many parameters.
The authors report that their datasets and models are publicly available.

narrative_sequence.summary: RAG is used to enhance web-based long-form question answering.
Generated long-form answers still lack factuality and clear logic.
The paper studies answer generation and introduces an outline-enhanced generator, datasets, and doubly fine-grained RLHF-based factuality optimization.
The proposed generic framework subsumes conventional fine-grained RLHF methods.
The authors report benchmark gains, a comparison favoring a smaller model, and public release of datasets and models.

unknowns: The abstract does not identify the datasets, benchmarks, or exact metric values.
The abstract does not describe the outline format, RLHF training procedure, or reward-model architecture.
The abstract does not provide independent verification of the reported results.
The abstract does not specify the scope, licensing, or contents of the released datasets and models.
